categories.validated_negative: Completed and reviewed under stated data/CV conditions but did not meet promotion criterion or has severe tails; not a universal impossibility or implementation bug.
categories.implementation_failure: An identified implementation/interface error; no such error is asserted for the archived R61/R62 methods.
categories.execution_incomplete: A specific timeout/failed/uncompleted execution attempt without a complete valid comparison; separate from method-level outcome.
categories.experimental_not_promoted: An experimental candidate with recorded evidence and open limitations, not a default/SDK-promoted method.
